plugin.name: Web Access
plugin.description: Search the web and read pages or PDFs inside a conversation — free by default, or with your own search and reader keys.
guidingWords.search: Search the web for the latest news on this and summarize what the sources say.
guidingWords.compare: Compare the current pricing of these three tools from their official pages.
guidingWords.read: Read this article and pull out the numbers I need, with the source links.
view.settings.label: Web Access
view.settings.description: Choose the search provider, add your own keys, and test the connection.
setup.title: Web Access
setup.ready: Search and page reading are ready. The free default needs no key.
settings.title: Search and page reading
settings.subtitle: The free default works with no key. Add a provider key only when you want your own quota, a private instance or a different index.
settings.search.provider.autoHint: Configured providers first, free Exa search last.
settings.search.searxngHint: Base URL of an instance with the JSON API enabled, e.g. https://search.example.com.
settings.fetch.remoteFallback: Use the hosted reader when a page cannot be read directly
settings.fetch.remoteFallbackHint: The page URL is sent to Exa (free) or Jina. Turn this off to keep every URL on your machine.
settings.privacy.allowPrivate: Allow reading local and private addresses
settings.privacy.allowPrivateHint: Off by default: the agent cannot reach localhost or your LAN through this plugin unless you turn it on.
settings.test.empty: No results came back. Try another query or provider.
tool.search.label: Web search
tool.fetch.label: Read page
settings.defaultNote: The free default returns {{results}} results per search and needs no key.
settings.test.hint: Runs one real query with the settings on this screen, before you save them.
settings.search.section.desc: Where queries go. Automatic walks your configured services and ends at the free endpoint.
settings.search.exaMcp.desc: Exa's public endpoint. Nothing to configure.
settings.search.exa.desc: Your own key: higher quota, page text included.
settings.search.brave.desc: Independent index, strong on news and fresh pages.
settings.search.searxng.desc: Point at an instance you run yourself.
settings.fetch.section.desc: How a page becomes readable text in the conversation.
settings.key.section.desc: Kept in the system credential store — never in settings.json.
settings.key.hint.exa: Semantic search that returns page text.
settings.key.hint.tavily: Built for agents; condensed, cite-ready text.
settings.key.hint.jina: A reader, not a search engine.
settings.privacy.section.desc: Boundaries the agent cannot cross on its own.
settings.fetch.mode.hint.auto: Reads the page from this machine first; a hosted reader is used only when that fails.
settings.fetch.mode.hint.direct: Only this machine requests the page — bot-walled pages return an error instead.
settings.fetch.mode.hint.jina: Every page goes through Jina Reader.
